items.title: UBS starts medtech coverage, favors Intuitive Surgical and Enovis
items.summary: Investing.com -- UBS initiated coverage on four U.S. medical technology companies on Monday, taking a bullish stance on robotic surgery specialist Intuitive Surgical and orthopedic products maker Enovis, while adopting a more cautious outlook on sleep apnea device manufacturer Inspire Medical Systems and a neutral view on Integra LifeSciences.
